prefix.description: Prefix of every object this package creates, e.g. `credit_` (Lore Spawner: `lore_`).

owner_table.description: The table whose rows own balances, purchases and usage (the app's users).

owner_id_column.description: The owner table's primary key column.

owner_id_type.description: That column's SQL type, e.g. `text` (Better Auth) or `uuid`.

server_role.description: The Hasura role (x-hasura-role) the app's server acts as; the only role that may move a balance.

user_role.description: The Hasura role a signed-in person acts as; reads their own balance, purchases, grants and usage.

usage_table.description: The usage ledger's table name (Lore Spawner: `ai_usage`).

min_purchase_cents.description: The smallest purchase or automatic refill, in cents of its currency.

table_settings.description: What the deployment hands out (one row: the monthly allotment). Lore Spawner keeps this in a settings table of its own with more columns. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_model_prices.description: Price versions, one per model and moment. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_model_price_kinds.description: What each kind of usage costs under a price version. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_kind_fallbacks.description: Kinds worked out from another when a price is set. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_price_factors.description: Multiples for a request's dimensions (where it ran, batch, fast). Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_dollar_rates.description: Credits per US dollar, a history. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_balances.description: Each user's free and bought credits. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_pool_budgets.description: The free pool's monthly budget in US dollars, a history. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_pool_periods.description: One month of the free pool: what came out of it. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_free_grants.description: Every handout of free credits from the pool. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_grants.description: The admin granting credits or taking some back. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_own_backends.description: A user's own model endpoint and sealed key. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_sale_prices.description: What a million credits cost per currency, a history. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_stripe_events.description: Stripe events that credited anything, by id. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_purchases.description: Purchases and automatic refills. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_autorefill.description: Each user's automatic refill settings. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_price_proposals.description: Prices proposed by a sync, waiting for the admin. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.

table_cost_reconciliations.description: Stretches of the ledger checked against the provider's cost report. Its table's name, so an app can keep a table it already has under another name.
